# Order for delivery of retained inspection notes

Applicant: ⟦PERSON|Alvena Ruskett⟧

Respondent: ⟦ORG|Bramble Purl Surveys Ltd⟧ (the Respondent)

## Penal notice

The respondent must comply with the delivery requirements stated below. A failure to comply may be brought before the court by a further application. This notice accompanies the order and does not enlarge the documents required to be delivered.

1. Within ten days, the respondent must provide the original inspection notes identified in the agreed index. A later summary spreadsheet is not a substitute for the handwritten source pages.
2. The respondent must state whether each indexed page is supplied as an original or a copy. If a page is unavailable, the accompanying inventory must explain whether it was lost, destroyed or never held.
3. Delivery must be arranged with the applicant's nominated collector, ⟦PERSON|Nerith MacVell⟧. The collector may acknowledge the number of packages received without accepting that every document is complete or legible.

The agreed delivery destination is ⟦ADDRESS|19 Quoin Road, Lincoln⟧. No authority is given to leave the originals with an unidentified neighbouring occupier. An attempted delivery does not discharge the obligation to provide the documents.

Costs of the application are reserved. Paragraph 6.2 of the earlier directions remains in force concerning retention of copies and inspection of the delivery record.

Order authenticated on 31 January 2027 by ⟦PERSON|Avren O’Kellane⟧.
